text:
maya: Heads-up — we need a small, prioritized bench probe run from runtime to validate a few claims for the launch post. Goal is a lightweight smoke + a focused variance probe, not a full sweep. Need ownership and ETA.

ajay: ack. can you list exact artifacts you need?

maya: Sure — minimal list: 1) raw per-request latency distribution (p50/p90/p99) for the test cohort, 2) token-level throughput and token-cost estimates, 3) warmup vs coldstart delta heatmap, 4) short CSV of payloads + model config used, 5) a single example of a quantized variant run (if available). Prefer within 48h for the core smoke.

sophia: tiny ask — can you include the exact seed payload set and a reproducible runner command? otherwise we spend time guessing. also flag which model variants count as "compatible fallback" for the public claim.

maya: good call. seed set = 250 queries drawn from our demo cohort (I uploaded the sample to drive: https://redwood.co/samples/launch-probe-250.csv). Runner: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RWD_KEY' \ 
  -d '{"model":"rw-large-v1","input_file":"launch-probe-250.csv","max_tokens":256,"stream":false}'
```
Use the exact model tag rw-large-v1:2026-03-10. For quantized variant try rw-large-v1-q4_0 if runtime supports it.

leo: tagging runtimebot for visibility — @runtimebot can you confirm runnable in next 48h and whether quantized path exists on the staging pool?

runtimebot: scheduled_job created: job_id=jb_2026_03_23_001. Estimated runtime 2.5h on staging-gpu-2. Quantized variant available on staging but fallback path may route to smaller variant under load.

ajay: thanks. priority note: marketing wants the smoke artifacts by EOD +2 days, but we should gate on a successful sanity run. I'll own the handoff if runtimebot returns green.

sophia: quick checklist for the run we need in the artifact bundle: 
- per-request CSV with latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, model_tag
- aggregate table (p50/p90/p99, avg tokens, cost_estimate)
- warmup heatmap image (cold vs warmed p90)
- note on any failed requests and error class
- the exact curl command + env vars redacted

maya: perfect. last ask: if the p99 for the quantized run regresses >15% vs baseline, abort and log config. We'll either swap to the smaller variant or mark in slide notes.

leo: runtimebot later: job jb_2026_03_23_001 completed (2h47m). Attachments: /artifacts/jb_2026_03_23_001/ (latency.csv, aggregates.json, heatmap.png, runner_cmd.txt). Quantized run p99 = 12% higher than baseline. No request failures.

ajay: grabbing artifacts now. will run basic ppt slide and a 1-paragraph caveat for comms. ETA 12h.

sophia: thank you. maya — do we want to surface the quantization caveat in the launch blurb or keep it for an appendix?

maya: include a small footnote in the blog and a detailed appendix for the webinar. marketing decision: highlight baseline numbers and call out quantized as "in-progress" with the 12% note.

leo: adding owner tags in the run ticket and closing the loop. cc: @sre-ops if anything else crops up during packaging. :thumbsup:
